NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Restore the accidentally deleted CSS block and comments (diff is now +35/-0, no deletions) |
| ✅  | Clean, minimal commit history (squashed into one commit with a description) |
| ⚠️  | Remove the out-of-scope `.buddy-list-user-link` focus block: the diff shrank from +56 to +35, but the author said on 06-15 that they had added it, so the diff needs a quick check |
| ⚠️  | Precise before/after screenshots: they are in the description, but the dark-theme before (370×60) and after (367×62) differ in size, so they are not the same region |
| ⚠️  | Style like the left sidebar link (blue ring, matching border radius): the outline color and offset are described, but the border radius is never mentioned |
| ℹ️  | CI status is not available; the author says all checks pass |
| ℹ️  | The same author has PR #39540 open on the same file, and was already told to focus on one PR at a time |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the screenshots and the border radius.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for cleaning up the commit and the diff! Two things are still open: the dark-theme before/after screenshots should cover exactly the same region (see [the guide on precise screenshots](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots)), and the focus ring's border radius should match the "Browse more channels" link in the left sidebar.
```
